answer: A single fake is a craft project; a hundred is an industry. Endorsed press card with press association attestation makes the industry visible: a card the association renews after newsroom audits. The spiral is the factory floor — the supervisors, the stamps, the histories, each needing its own room. Each unit needs its own supervisor and its own paper trail, and the comet is the floor manager: one person coordinating lies full-time, leaving a trail in every ledger they touch. The walnut is the pattern across all hundred, which the checker sees at once.
